H1.question: Does cross-node communication add value beyond matched single-node rescoring?
H1.primary_evidence: TG_A versus N0_A with same seed S64, inputs, training budget, and postprocessing

H2.question: Does learned communication add value beyond simple cyclic smoothing?
H2.primary_evidence: TG_D versus cal50-selected BestSimple_D under exact common 65-state DP

H3.question: Is whole-contour reach necessary beyond a long local window?
H3.evidence: TG versus T32 under matched initialization and training

H4.question: Is any TG advantage more than moving less?
H4.evidence: cal50-matched movement budgets on dev100 and separated-peak correction diagnostics

H5.question: Was the old local baseline suppressed by its eight-epoch budget?
H5.evidence: S64/S96 minimum 12 epochs, common stop200 rule, epoch8 snapshot, training-budget edge reporting

interpretation_limit: These development hypotheses cannot establish independent test validity or publication novelty by themselves
